about_page_subtitle: Your passion for figurines, our mission
our_mission_text: FiguVerse was born from a passion for the world of collectible figurines. Our mission is to create the largest French-speaking community dedicated to anime, manga and video game figurines, offering a space for sharing, discovery and exchange for all collectors.
our_story_text: Created in 2023 by figurine enthusiasts, FiguVerse quickly evolved from a simple personal blog to a complete platform. We started by sharing our own collections and reviews, then developed partnerships with major manufacturers and distributors to bring you the latest information.
team_founder_bio: Collector for 15 years, specialized in shonen and Japanese RPG figurines.
team_manager_bio: Community management and event hosting. Passionate about magical girls.
team_reviewer_bio: Expert in figurine quality and new releases. Mecha and sci-fi specialist.
value_passion_text: We share your love for figurines and the universe of Japanese pop culture.

value_accessibility_text: Making collecting accessible to everyone, beginners and experts alike.
